environment.description: Service deployed in VPC subnet (subnet-0a3f8c) with route table rtb-7e2d containing only local route (10.0.4.0/24 -> local) and no 0.0.0.0/0 destination entry. Subnet has no NAT Gateway, no NAT Instance, no VPC endpoint for any AWS service, and no VPC peering connection with internet-routable paths. Network ACL (acl-9b1c3f) applied to subnet has explicit DENY on all egress to 0.0.0.0/0 for all protocols (rule 50), with only ALLOW for 10.0.4.0/24 intra-subnet (rule 100 inbound/outbound). Security group sg-4a8f2e allows inbound TCP 8080 from 10.0.0.0/16 only, egress allows TCP to 10.0.4.0/24 only. VPC flow logs confirm zero packets to any destination outside 10.0.4.0/24 in trailing 90 days. DNS resolution configured via Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint within same subnet for internal zones only - no forwarder to public DNS.

config.dns: Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint, internal zones only
config.flow_log_evidence: zero egress packets outside 10.0.4.0/24 in 90 days
